blogs.name: The Splice Blog
blogs.verificationMethod: Splice is a real African salon/spa booking & business-management platform (confirmed via its own Facebook page). Fetched a live article on the blog matching the resource directory's barbing description almost word for word; page metadata confirms WordPress + Elementor, which defaults to a /feed/ RSS endpoint. Raw XML not fetched directly (no outbound network in the build sandbox) — same one-curl check as entrepreneurs.ng before shipping. NOTE: do not confuse with splice.com/blog, an unrelated music-production company.
